data.name: Just Barricade!
data.detailed_description:
The most important thing in this game is to protect your home at any cost!

BUILDING

Inside your home, you'll be able to build ANY structures that will help you survive dangerous events. You'll have to build fortifications, additional doors, traps, barricades, and other engineering solutions. The only limit is physics.

REALISTIC INTERACTION

Every object must be interacted with just like in real life. Every action has its own dedicated key.

CHARACTER HEALTH & CONTROLS

To survive, you'll need to take care of your needs: food, water, fatigue, stress, and health. The character has a fully simulated set of organs, bones, and arteries. You will die when oxygenated blood stops reaching your brain. Your character can crouch, blink, move objects, and even control their body while falling thanks to a controllable ragdoll system.

RAIDS & EVENTS

During the day or at night, when you least expect it, different events can happen to you. Police raids, mafia raids, extreme weather conditions, or even just a cruel prank.

EARNING MONEY & SURVIVAL

To survive and succeed, you'll need money for food, medicine, weapons, and building materials. The game offers different ways to earn money — both legal and illegal.

MAPS & DIVERSE GAMEPLAY

At the beginning of the game, you can choose a map and difficulty, or simply test the physics, experiment with the game's features, and try out different mechanics in Sandbox Mode.

Don't let your home become your grave.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: System requirements may change during development.
